name: ModifyDBClusterTDE

parameters.help_en: The TDE status. Set the value to Enable
parameters.name: tde_status

parameters.help_en: The Global Resource Descriptor of the role. You can use this parameter to specify a role. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93689.html
parameters.help_zh: 角色的全局资源描述符，用来指定具体角色。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93689.html
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom key
parameters.name: encryption_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically encrypt all new tables. Valid values:

ON

OFF

This parameter is valid only when the database engine is compatible with MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动加密所有新建的表。取值：

ON：开启

OFF：关闭

仅当数据库引擎为MySQL兼容时，该参数生效
parameters.name: encrypt_new_tables

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically rotate the TDE key of the instance during the next O\&M window after a new version of the KMS key is available. This parameter is valid only for custom keys.

true

false

This parameter is supported only when the database engine is compatible with PostgreSQL or Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许实例TDE密钥在检测到KMS密钥版本变更时，于轮转周期后最近的运维时间进行自动轮转。仅自定义密钥支持该参数。
true：允许
false：不允许
仅当数据库引擎为PostgreSQL兼容或Oracle语法兼容时，支持该参数
parameters.name: enable_automatic_rotation
